metadata.title: आदिवासियों पर बरपाई गई बर्बरता की कहानी | Story of barbaric attack on tribals of Vachati
metadata.description: In 1992, the village of Vachati survived a brutal incursion, by the forces of state. A raid was conducted with a raid party consisting 270, Forest guard, Police and Revenue officials.  The houses of tribals were destructed, tribals were beaten, women were raped and cattle were killed. After this a false case was registered. The legal battle took 31 long years, and on 23 September 2023, Madras High Court pronounced a Judgement.
